question: According to the NITI Aayog report of 2021, what percentage of the population of rural India is living below the poverty line?
solution:
The correct answer is __**32.75%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** poverty line** in India is defined as the minimum level of income required to meet the basic needs of a person.
 
• It is **calculated based on** the cost of a **basket of essential goods and services.**
 
• **Poverty in rural India is a major issue**, with a large proportion of the population living in extreme poverty.
 
• The **lack of infrastructure, education, and job opportunities** are some of the main reasons for this.
 
• The NITI Aayog report highlights the **need for targeted interventions to address poverty in rural India**, such as providing access to basic services like healthcare, education, and sanitation, and promoting livelihood opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog):**

 
• The NITI Aayog has **replaced the Planning Commission**, which has a 65-year history.
 
• **Narendra Modi **is the **present chairman **of NITI Aayog.
 
• **Suman Bery **is the **present vice chairman **of NITI Aayog.
 
• **B.V.R. Subrahmanyam **is the **present** NITI Aayog's **CEO**.
 
• **Chief Ministers** from every State and **Lieutenant Governors **of India's Union Territories **make up the Governing Council.**
 
• It’s creation has two hubs. They are:
 
 
• **Team India Hub**: It leads to the central government and the Indian states cooperation.
 
• **Knowledge and Innovation Hub: **It enhances the organization's capacity as a think tank.
 
 
 
• The core components of the NITI Aayog is the **seven pillars of effective governance**. They are:
 
 
• Pro-People.
 
• Pro-Activity.
 
• Participation.
 
• Empowering.
 
• Inclusion of all.
 
• Equality.
 
• Transparency.
